BIG SHOUT!!!! from Hotrod!!

Guys I need to say that I have a lot of guilt in me. You guys strive so hard and take so much time to answer questions and make these posts and charts for the benefit of whoever comes across them. The time I have put into this community is minuscule compared to what I have gotten out of it. I feel I owe an explanation. This is no excuse because I know everyone of you have busy lives and are still finding the time to contribute. I am usually working more than full time at 12 hours a day, I have 6 children who all need group family time and individual daddy time, and a wonderful wife who needs help with the housework and time with her husband. That leaves very little time to put towards studying and posting as well. This is why you see me pop up every few months eager to dig in and then fade away within a few days. I start feeling guilty for my family, and they have to come first. I have a burning desire to understand the market as well as you guys, but I just can't put it ahead of the people who need me. I feel awful saying this because I have read IF's story and know what he has sacrificed. But there is no telling how many thousands of lives IF has touched and changed with his generosity and I pray that all the pain and suffering he has gone through gets mended and he enjoys the personal life that he so richly deserves.

There will come a day when I have no need for a full time job. I will then make use of that time and strive to have the same impact on humanity that all of you are having now. I will help as many as I can to get out from underneath the machinations of these bloodsucking greedy bastards who designed them just so they can have a bit more status than the bloodsucking greedy bastard sitting next to him. I'm not talking about wealthy people who want to give a hand up to others willing to work for it. I'm talking about the people at the top who designed this whole banking and economic system to keep the vast majority of humanity on a treadmill and getting no where for all there back breaking labor while they sit back laughing and reaping all the rewards of that labor.(not trying to start a big discussion here, just take it as my view on the world)

Sorry I guess I just can't help but be long winded. Thank you so much for all you do, but until that day comes I have the responsibility of raising 6 children to be caring, compassionate, loving, and giving of themselves to help others.

Hotrod, you're doing exactly the right thing.Love and cherish that family of yours. The markets will still be here when they're standing on their own feet.

The latter part of your post explains so calmly what my mind is screaming daily:) Thanks so much for posting

Best to the family

If
